title: Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 Introduced in Lok Sabha
content:
# Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 Introduced in Lok Sabha

Ek important update hai. Government ne "Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026" Lok Sabha mein introduce kiya hai. This Bill was presented on August 4, 2026, and aims to bring in significant amendments to existing tax and settlement laws.

This legislation seeks to replace the Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026, which was promulgated on June 5, 2026. The primary objective is to introduce various tax reliefs, promote investment, and enhance tax certainty across different sectors.

Key proposals in the Bill include:
*   **Amendments to Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007:** The Bill proposes to amend Section 10A of the Act, which may affect charges on notified electronic payment modes.
*   **Income-tax Act, 2025 and Finance Act, 2026 Amendments:**
    *   **Dividend Distribution:** It streamlines the taxation of dividend distributions by business trusts.
    *   **Electronics Manufacturing:** Tax exemptions for foreign companies involved in electronics contract manufacturing are proposed to be extended by ten years, up to the Tax Year 2040-41.
    *   **Bonded Warehouses:** Tax exemptions are provided for foreign companies storing components in bonded warehouses.
    *   **Offshore Investment Funds:** The Bill also aims to significantly simplify the framework for offshore investment funds managed from India, relaxing eligibility conditions to promote fund management activity and provide greater tax certainty.

This move is intended to mitigate external economic shocks, support key sectors, maintain stability in the domestic economy, improve ease of doing business, and provide greater tax certainty amidst evolving global conditions.
